analysis_summary.notes: This patch adds the --log-queries=only_failed option to dnsmasq. All changes are purely additive: a new static helper error_occured(), a new OPT_LOG_ONLY_FAILED option constant (78) with OPT_LAST bumped to 79, a conditional early return in log_query() gated by the new option, and CLI parsing for the new "only_failed" keyword. Existing CLI values (extra, proto, auth) continue to work identically. No breaking or behavioral compatibility changes identified.
